answer: Rotate the scarce resource the network demands each epoch — compute, storage, bandwidth, live attention — announced only at the start, so a farm tuned for one class cannot cover them all. Each identity's proof is pressed like shale into a public ledger of layers, and only identities that complete the full rotation reach the summit of that epoch's payout. Like yarrow that blooms only in its own tended soil, each class needs its own provisioning; a hundred clones need a hundred of every class at once, so cost multiplies across classes while one honest agent adapts once.
